client.business_model: Super-regional fresh food distributor operating a network of temperature-controlled warehouses and a large truck fleet serving foodservice and retail customers across the Mid-West and Southeastern United States.
client.client_history: FreshEdge was formed in 2019 through the combination of IF&P Foods and Get Fresh Produce. The company has expanded rapidly via a series of acquisitions and now ranks among the largest independent fresh food distributors in the U.S. In October 2022 it was acquired by Chicago-based private equity firm Wind Point Partners, with the founding leadership team retaining a meaningful stake.

revenue.notes: Buzzfile lists $254.3 M annual revenue. GetLatka reports $42.8 M (2025) which is inconsistent with the firm’s >2,000 employee count. No figure is provided in press releases or the company website. Using the Buzzfile figure but confidence kept low due to conflicting third-party estimates and lack of official disclosure.

locations.notes: Article quoting FreshEdge states the company operates "over 1.3 million square feet across 35 facilities". Businesswire release (Oct-2022) cited 25 facilities. Increase aligns with 2023-2024 acquisitions; treating 35 as current but only medium confidence as no facilities list on website.

employees.notes: Article says the company employed "approximately 2,800 individuals". Earlier 2022 articles noted >2,000 following acquisitions, supporting the higher 2025 figure.

extraction_sources: Assessment/Spend Analysis FreshEdge 07.12.2023.xlsx (client name in multiple sheets)
Businesswire press release 04-Oct-2022 (Rotunda Capital Partners Completes Sale of FreshEdge)
Wind Point Partners website deal announcement (wppartners.com, Oct-2022)
extraction_notes: Official legal name appears in multiple internal documents and press releases as "FreshEdge" or "FreshEdge, LLC" – LLC designation retained for formality.
PE ownership confirmed by both Wind Point Partners site and Businesswire press release; earlier backing by Rotunda Capital Partners noted but current sponsor is Wind Point Partners.
Revenue figures are not officially disclosed. Third-party sources conflict sharply; chose higher Buzzfile estimate as it aligns better with employee scale but confidence kept low.
EBITDA not disclosed in any internal or external source reviewed.
Locations count varies by year (25 in 2022 press release, 35 in 2024 article); selected most recent figure and assigned medium confidence.
Employee count corroborated by multiple news items tracking acquisitions; LinkedIn did not publish a specific headcount figure.
